description: Robin returns from the Holy Land carrying deep loss into a Nottingham destabilized by Prince John, Isabella and old family secrets, forcing bitter enemies into uneasy alliances before the final battle.

s03e01.description: Robin returns from the Holy Land consumed by grief and vengeance against Gisborne until Tuck arrives convinced that England still needs Robin Hood.

s03e02.description: The Sheriff sells local men as soldiers to Irish warriors, and Robin's attempt to stop the conscription leaves him facing execution.

s03e03.description: The Sheriff forces an abbot to accuse Robin's gang of stealing from the church, leaving Tuck to clear their names before the trap becomes an execution.

s03e04.description: A revenge-seeking outlaw kidnaps Allan and Kate, prompting Robin to seize the man's son and begin a dangerous exchange.

s03e05.description: Gisborne returns with Prince John's elite guards and a new weapon, while Little John is separated from the gang and thrown into a gladiatorial circus.

s03e06.description: Prince John arrives in Nottingham and pits the Sheriff and Gisborne against one another while Robin pursues a dangerous romantic distraction.

s03e07.description: A heat wave becomes a weapon when Prince John blocks Nottinghamshire's wells, forcing the outlaws to fight for water while Robin's private relationship is exposed.

s03e08.description: News of King Richard's death triggers a rush toward Prince John's coronation, but Robin suspects the message and confronts a former mentor to stop it.

s03e09.description: Gisborne awaits execution as Robin tries to bargain with the new Sheriff Isabella, until someone from her past arrives seeking revenge.

s03e10.description: A mysterious figure forces Robin and Gisborne to confront the hidden history of their parents, revealing why their lives became so violently entangled.

s03e11.description: Robin shocks the gang by allying with Gisborne, then travels to York with him to save their newly discovered half-brother from execution.

s03e12.description: Isabella begins rounding up men for Prince John while Archer plays both sides, drawing Robin and Gisborne into a trap as a greater threat approaches Nottingham.

s03e13.description: The Sheriff's army attacks Nottingham in force, leaving Robin and the surviving outlaws to defend the castle in a final battle for the city.
